paragraph: In June 2025 [the SNCP director said public contracting entities publish their procedures and annual plans on the Portal de Compras Públicas](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/sncp-perspectiva-plataforma-para-facilitar-contratacao-publica/>). [In June 2022 the national procurement service director said the Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica, launched in April 2018, processed public purchases online](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/estado-poupa-kz-110-mil-milhoes-em-compras-publicas-online/>). [It had run 1,959 tender procedures since 2018](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/estado-poupa-kz-110-mil-milhoes-em-compras-publicas-online/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs end to end or is required of all public bodies. Operating would need e-procurement that runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies.

[PAFEN issued a World Bank-financed request for proposals on 23 September 2026](<https://armp.gov.bi/archives/12100>) to design, build and deploy an end-to-end electronic public procurement system. Proposals were due on 13 November 2026. [The finance minister said the platform is due to enter into force from 2027](<https://indundi.com/le-burundi-sachemine-vers-la-digitalisation-des-marches-publics-a-travers-la-plateforme-e-gp/>), with first tests expected in early 2027. Both dates are within the last twelve months. No earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

A 2024 evaluation cited by ARMP [looked at 757 calls published on SIGMaP in 2023](<https://armp.bj/le-benin-franchit-une-nouvelle-etape-dans-la-dematerialisation-de-la-commande-publique/>) and found that only 21 reached the automatic contract page. In the last twelve months, [the Treasury announced on 19 December 2025 that a new e-Procurement platform will replace SIGMAP](<https://www.tresorbenin.bj/actualite/seizieme-edition-du-vendredi-des-reformes-a-la-dgtcp-ce-19-decembre-2025>). It comes under decree 2025-169 of 9 April 2025. [ARMP says the platform is still being acquired and implemented](<https://armp.bj/le-benin-franchit-une-nouvelle-etape-dans-la-dematerialisation-de-la-commande-publique/>). No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs end to end or is required of all public bodies. The latest dated fact is the Treasury announcement of 19 December 2025.

[The finance ministry's 2025 public-finance report, cited by OuagaNews, says the procurement-planning module was fully configured on the E-Burkindi platform](<https://ouaganews.net/burkina-759-des-marches-publics-par-procedures-exceptionnelles-en-2025/>). The module was piloted with ministries and institutions in 2025. [A World Bank-backed project set out in 2022 to acquire, adapt and deploy an online e-GP solution for Burkina Faso](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099730003022212412/pdf/Burkina0Faso000t000Procurement0Plan.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says government tenders are published or bid online on E-Burkindi. None gives a figure for its use. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[The PPRA said in December 2025 that it is working with the Ministry of Finance to develop a national e-procurement system](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/89320>). [In March 2026 its chief executive told the National Public Procurement Pitso that Botswana has no fully integrated e-procurement platform and runs manual processes](<https://weekendpost.co.bw/botswanas-procurement-system-at-crossroads-amid-reform-efforts/>). A national system is promised by 2027. [The PPADB had launched an Integrated Procurement Management System with online submission in July 2016](<https://www.sundaystandard.info/ppadb-launches-a-web-based-bidding-system/>). Both PPRA statements are from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[The finance ministry told the Council of Ministers at the end of 2023 that SIGOMAP is the sole platform for managing public procurement](<https://www.marchespublics.ci/uploads/doc/Projet_CCM_March%C3%A9s_2023.pdf>). [The Budget Ministry had opened online procurement on SIGOMAP on 25 July 2023](<https://budget.gouv.ci/357-about-actualites.html>), where firms consult notices, buy tender files and submit bids. The same communication says use extends to all contracting authorities of the ministries from 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says SIGOMAP runs to award or payment or is required of all public bodies. Operating would need e-procurement that runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies.

[The public-contracts minister told the National Assembly's finance committee that Coleps, launched in 2018, published 2,334 tender notices in 2025](<https://ecomatin.net/cameroun-lattribution-des-marches-publics-en-ligne-bondit-de-221-a-1-173-contrats-en-un-an>). It awarded 1,173 contracts from them, against 365 awards from 458 notices in 2024. [The second version of COLEPS was launched on 25 June 2025](<https://www.cameroon-tribune.cm/article.html/71737/fr.html/dematerialising-public-contracts-procedures-merits-of-e-procurement>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, the procurement regulator [began training 20 procurement officers in Littoral to use Pridesoft](<https://www.cameroon-tribune.cm/article.html/82737/fr.html/marches-publics-20-acteurs-du-littoral-mis-au-numerique>), the integrated procurement system. Exclusive electronic award is compulsory from the 2027 financial year. The latest dated fact is that training in November 2026.

[ARMP said in April 2026 that SIGMAP is not yet in production and that training comes first](<https://armp-rdc.cd/loperationnalisation-du-systeme-integre-de-gestion-des-marches-publics-au-menu-des-echanges-entre-le-vice-premier-ministre-ministre-du-budget-et-directeur-general-de-larmp/>). This came after a decree on electronic procurement of October 2024. [ARMP said in March 2026 that pilot procurement cells were equipped through World Bank projects](<https://armp-rdc.cd/larmp-et-la-dgcmp-se-concertent-en-vue-de-loperationnalisation-du-systeme-integre-de-gestion-des-marches-publics-sigmap/>). [Ecofin Agency says SIGMAP was launched in August 2022 after delays](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-services/0110-59397-drc-moves-to-expand-public-procurement-access-for-msmes-and-start-ups>), and a shared services centre for procurement opened in June 2026. The April and March 2026 statements are from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[Decree 2024-2072 of 10 October 2024 establishes an e-GP system run by ARMP](<https://armp.cg/markets-legal.php>), from programming to archiving. In the last twelve months, [a workshop on 4 June 2026 validated the draft bidding document for the firm that will build it](<https://www.aci.cg/congo-gouvernance-vers-la-validation-du-projet-dao-pour-une-nouvelle-generation-de-marche-publics/>). [ARMP says a workshop on 21-22 July 2026 adopted the tender file, pending the steering committee](<https://www.armp.cg/news-detail.php?id=11>). The decree is the earlier position, and no source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[In September 2025 a consultant report said Comoros is pursuing a reform to set up an e-Government Procurement system](<https://armpcomores.km/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Rapport_final_Diagnostic_institutionnel_MP_Comores_Clean1.pdf>). [It specifies an online tendering platform of two modules, with hosting](<https://armpcomores.km/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Rapport_final_Diagnostic_institutionnel_MP_Comores_Clean1.pdf>). [A draft e-GP implementing decree was under review](<https://armpcomores.km/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Rapport_final_Diagnostic_institutionnel_MP_Comores_Clean1.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs end to end, is required of all public bodies, or gives a figure. No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

The government said in March 2026 that [electronic public procurement has existed in Cabo Verde since 2020](<https://www.governo.cv/nota-de-esclarecimento-publico-plataforma-eletronica-de-contratacao-publica/>). Central State Administration procedures are carried out through the official public purchasing portal. In the last twelve months it also said that [a new e-procurement platform was awarded to ACIN-iCloud Solutions for CVE 70,000,000 over four years](<https://www.governo.cv/nota-de-esclarecimento-publico-plataforma-eletronica-de-contratacao-publica/>). The new platform is to extend e-procurement to local administration and to autonomous services and funds. No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs end to end or is required of all public bodies. Operating would need e-procurement that runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies.

[Decree 2023-038/PRE of February 2023 instituted the electronic public procurement portal](<https://www.journalofficiel.dj/texte-juridique/decret-n2023-038-pre-instituant-le-portail-electronique-des-marches-publics/>). It requires contracting authorities to publish notices, tender documents and cancellations on it. [RTD reported in October 2026 that the portal, launched in May 2023, lists 1,300 published contracts and 1,227 recorded awards since 2021](<https://rtd.dj/le-premier-ministre-par-interim-participe-au-deuxieme-colloque-regional/>). In the last twelve months, RTD also reported that electronic bid submission, e-signature and digital tracking of payments are planned over 2026-2028. A platform covering the whole cycle is due by 2027. Bids are not yet submitted online. Nothing found since October 2023 says the portal is required of all public bodies.

[In December 2021 the finance ministry launched a portal for exchanging procurement documents and information](<https://www.mf.gov.dz/index.php/fr/activites-2/808-lancement-officiel-du-portail-electronique-dedie-aux-marches-publics>), with procurement to be dematerialised progressively. In the last twelve months, [TSA reported in March 2026 that Algeria has officially launched an electronic public procurement portal](<https://www.tsa-algerie.com/lalgerie-lance-un-portail-electronique-dedie-au-marches-publics/>). [The portal operates under law 23-12 of 5 August 2023](<https://www.tsa-algerie.com/lalgerie-lance-un-portail-electronique-dedie-au-marches-publics/>). [Firms download tender documents free and submit bids on it](<https://www.tsa-algerie.com/lalgerie-lance-un-portail-electronique-dedie-au-marches-publics/>). No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs end to end or is required of all public bodies. Operating would need e-procurement that runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies.

[On 4 August 2025 Finance Minister Ahmed Kouchouk said Egypt's national electronic procurement platform was close to completion](<https://www.dailynewsegypt.com/2025/08/04/electronic-public-procurement-platform-nears-completion-kouchouk/>). He said it was not yet in operation. No later source found says it has gone live. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says government tenders are published or bid on the platform. None gives a figure for its use. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[The Public Procurement and Property Administration Authority says 172 federal institutions and 196 branch offices used its e-GP platform in fiscal year 2025/26](<https://birrmetrics.com/public-procurement-authority-reports-597bn-birr-in-digital-transactions/>). [Its Director General says more than 597 billion birr in completed transactions went through e-GP that year](<https://birrmetrics.com/public-procurement-authority-reports-597bn-birr-in-digital-transactions/>). [The Authority said 308.75 billion birr went through it in EFY 2017](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_7113934>). It also says e-GP automates bidding, evaluation, contract signing and payment. In the last twelve months, in November 2026, [Addis Ababa's finance bureau ordered 48 of the city's largest-spending agencies onto the electronic procurement platform](<https://birrmetrics.com/addis-ababa-bars-former-bid-officials-from-public-tenders/>). The latest dated fact is that order.

[On 27 December 2021 the Budget Minister launched the digital Journal des marchés publics at lejmp.ga](<http://news.alibreville.com/h/104877.html>), which publishes tender notices and results online. In the last twelve months, [on 15 January 2026 the Ministry of Economy and Finance launched SIGFiP](<https://lejmp.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/JMP_JanvFev210326.pdf>), which handles public procurement among all revenue and spending operations. Some procurement modules work and others are still being built. No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[The Public Procurement Authority says GHANEPS, launched on 30 April 2019, had reached 869 public entities in all 16 regions by September 2023](<https://ppa.gov.gh/mandatory-use-of-the-ghana-electronic-procurement-system-ghaneps-for-all-government-procurement/>). [It said in November 2023 that the grace period had ended](<https://ppa.gov.gh/mandatory-use-of-the-ghana-electronic-procurement-system-ghaneps-for-all-government-procurement/>) and all public entities must use GHANEPS. [It says 5,048 contracts had been awarded in GHANEPS from 3,205 published tenders by 23 April 2024](<https://ppa.gov.gh/clarification-of-claims-made-by-mr-bright-simons/>). [Its board chairman said in October 2025 that utilisation of GHANEPS is about 45%](<https://icnghana.com/finance-ministry-reaffirms-commitment-to-transparent-procurement-ghaneps-to-become-mandatory-from-2026/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact is that October 2025 statement.

[Guinea rolled out TELEMO, a national e-procurement platform built through a Guinea-Rwanda South-South partnership](<https://smartafrica.org/fr/le-transform-africa-summit-2025-confirme-la-dynamique-continentale-pour-une-afrique-digitale-unie-et-souveraine-depuis-la-guinee>). It was officially launched on 17 November 2025. In the last twelve months, [the procurement regulator ARMP said Télémo entered a new phase of use in September 2026, with companies registering on it](<https://armpguinee.org/commande-publique-larmp-la-dgcmp-et-la-banque-mondiale-font-le-point-sur-levolution-telemo/>). No earlier position has been found for that phase. No source found since October 2023 says government tenders are published or bid online through Télémo. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[In August 2025 GPPA Director General Phoday Jaiteh said the authority had implemented a new e-procurement portal over the past two years](<https://foroyaa.net/procurement-drives-value-in-managing-resources-says-gppa-dg-jaiteh/>), which streamlined business registration. In the last twelve months, [the Gambia Public Procurement Authority's training of 8 to 10 October 2026 covered the rollout of the Electronic Government Procurement system](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/national-news/gppa-trains-procurement-cadre-on-new-act-regulations-and-standard-documents>). Its Board Vice Chairperson said the system will digitise the procurement cycle. No source found since October 2023 says government tenders are published or bid online through a system in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[Law 11/2025 of 12 December 2025 brings in GE Compras, an electronic procurement information system for submitting and evaluating bids](<https://jonesandsacristan.es/blog-single.php?id=72>). A law firm's January 2026 article reports this and does not say the system is live. [TACD CARTENA says the finance ministry mandated it, with AfDB support, to design an e-GP system](<https://www.tacdcartena.org/actualite/tacd-cartena-prepare-la-strategie-pour-la-mise-en-oeuvre-dun-systeme-electronique-de-passation-des-marches-en-guinee-equatoriale/>), with a readiness report and roadmap. The law is from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[Treasury Cabinet Secretary John Mbadi said in August 2025 that e-GP was operational across government](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/treasury-to-fast-track-rollout-of-electronic-procurement-system/>). [K24 Digital reported in October 2025 that 1,477 procuring entities were listed on it, with no tender then awarded](<https://k24.digital/411/new-procurement-system-yet-to-award-a-single-tender-4-months-after-launch>). In the last twelve months, [Mbadi said in the 2026/27 Budget Statement that all procurement by government entities goes through e-GP from 1 July 2026](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-06-11-all-government-procurement-to-go-through-e-gp-from-july-1>). [He said in November 2026 that contracts worth about KSh 18.3 billion had been processed through it](<https://ipfglobal.or.ke/ipf-and-treasury-review-kenyas-electronic-government-procurement-e-gp-progress-as-reform-enters-second-year/>). The figure is the Treasury's own, and no share of all government purchasing has been found.

[President Boakai launched e-GP on 6 February 2025 for online bidding and made its use mandatory for all government procuring entities](<https://gnnliberia.com/president-boakai-launches-mandatory-e-gp-system-to-boost-transparency-in-public-procurement/>). [PPCC executive director Bodger Scott Johnson said in September 2025 that contracts worth US$12,219,000 had been awarded through e-GP](<https://www.thenewdawnliberia.com/liberian-companies-benefit-contracts-valued-over-us12-million/>). In the last twelve months, [PPCC said 56 procurement entities were onboarded as Phase II of the rollout began in May 2026](<https://www.ppcc.gov.lr/media/press-release/liberia-advances-digital-procurement-ppcc-begins-phase-ii-e-gp-training>). No figure for the share of government purchasing through e-GP has been found.

[The General Information Authority reports 626 tenders announced on Attaat, the Tripoli government's procurement website, during July 2025](<https://www.gia.gov.ly/en/2025/08/03/6665/>). [They were published by 189 government entities, with 840 entities registered on the platform](<https://libyaherald.com/2025/08/tripoli-libyan-governments-official-tendering-and-procurement-website-attaat-is-operational>). [The Authority's head announced in February 2024 that the updated platform had started operating](<https://www.gia.gov.ly/2024/03/11/%d8%b1%d8%a6%d9%8a%d8%b3-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a6%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%a7%d9%85%d8%a9-%d9%84%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%88%d9%85%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d9%8a%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%86-%d8%a8%d8%af%d8%a1/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says e-procurement runs end to end or is required of all public bodies. The latest dated fact is the July 2025 count.

[A World Bank blog says the portal opened in 2007](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/fr/arabvoices/greening-moroccan-economy-through-e-procurement>) and that [68% of bids were filed online in June 2022](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/fr/arabvoices/greening-moroccan-economy-through-e-procurement>), against 15% in December 2019. [A ministerial order in force from September 2023 puts bid filing on the portal](<https://lematin.ma/express/2023/marches-publicslessentiel-larrete-relatif-dematerialisation/393581.html>). In the last twelve months, [an Al3omk op-ed says the Treasury suspended its procurement portal in late October 2026](<https://al3omk.com/1205193.html>). Bid deadlines were put back as a result. No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies. Operating would need e-procurement that runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies.

[ARMP and UNDP trained central actors on an earlier e-GP platform in 2022](<http://www.armp.mg/site/A%20la%20une/eGP_Operationnel.php>). In the last twelve months, [PREA said in February 2026 that the e-GP strategy is validated and an implementation firm is about to be deployed](<https://prea.gov.mg/banque-mondiale/%f0%9d%97%b2-%f0%9d%97%9a%f0%9d%97%bc%f0%9d%98%83%f0%9d%97%b2%f0%9d%97%bf%f0%9d%97%bb%f0%9d%97%ba%f0%9d%97%b2%f0%9d%97%bb%f0%9d%98%81-%f0%9d%97%a3%f0%9d%97%bf%f0%9d%97%bc%f0%9d%97%b0%f0%9d%98%82/>). [PREA reports that the e-GP project team held a field mission in Boeny and Atsimo Andrefana in June 2026 to prepare nationwide deployment](<https://prea.gov.mg/e-gp/>). No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether government e-procurement is under way or in service in Mali. Every source found for it is dated 2021 or earlier. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that public procurement runs on paper.

[The government launched the e-GP project in April 2025, to be delivered in phases](<https://economia.gov.mz/governo-lanca-projecto-de-contratacao-publica-electronica-e-gp/>). [European Dynamics says it won the contract to supply and install the national e-GP system](<https://www.eurodyn.com/the-government-of-mozambique-selects-epps-for-its-national-eprocurement-system/>). [In December 2024 the CEDSIF chair said most electronic procurement in e-SISTAFE's state asset module was operational](<https://www.jornalnoticias.co.mz/destaque/e-sistafe-passa-a-ser-ferramenta-de-auditoria/>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026, [O Economico tied the finance ministry's procurement reform to the e-CP system](<https://www.oeconomico.com/estado-centraliza-compras-publicas-e-coloca-nova-estrutura-sob-auditoria-externa-anual/>), which it does not say is in service. No source found since the April 2025 launch says tenders are published or bid online through a system in service. Establishing would need government tenders published or bid online through a system in service.

[ARMP and the digital ministry launched the national public procurement portal on 3 December 2024](<https://emergence.mr/2024/12/05/lancement-du-portail-national-des-marches-publics-en-mauritanie/>), which carries procurement plans, tender announcements and results. In the last twelve months, [the digital ministry said in July 2026 that SIGMAP's programming phase has run since early 2026](<https://trustmag.net/article/hDaLLNiaP>). Tender-file management and electronic bid submission are in testing. [The ministry counts 200 contracting authorities, over 600 users and 274 procurement plans on SIGMAP](<https://trustmag.net/article/hDaLLNiaP>). No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs end to end or is required of all public bodies. Operating would need e-procurement that runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies.

[The Procurement Policy Office says the web-based e-Procurement System was launched in September 2015](<https://ppo.govmu.org/Documents/Annual%20Reports/Annual%20Report%202023-2024.pdf>) and that [government made its use mandatory from July 2020](<https://ppo.govmu.org/Documents/Annual%20Reports/Annual%20Report%202023-2024.pdf>). [In 2023/24 public bodies published 7,681 electronic invitations for bids and received 18,599 electronic bid submissions](<https://ppo.govmu.org/Documents/Annual%20Reports/Annual%20Report%202023-2024.pdf>), and 116 of 205 public bodies used it. [A MAPS assessment finds use selective, with bid evaluation and award often offline](<https://www.mapsinitiative.org/content/dam/maps-initiative/en/assessments/mauritius/maps-assessment-mauritius-e-proc-report.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact is that [tender documents were published on the Public Procurement Portal in September 2025](<https://publicnotice.govmu.org/publicnotice/?p=28880>).

[The PPDA reports 562 tenders published on MANePS by 5 October 2026, with 7,417 registered suppliers](<https://www.ppda.mw/newsdetail/89>). [A Treasury circular makes MANePS mandatory for all procuring entities from 1 April 2026](<https://www.ppda.mw/newsdetail/58>). [Nation Online reports MANePS was formally launched with 174 procuring entities onboarded](<https://mwnation.com/govt-rolls-out-digital-procurement-system/>), and says it manages the cycle from planning and tendering to award and payment. In the last twelve months, [Phase II features were in testing with 18 entities for November 2026](<https://www.ppda.mw/newsdetail/84>). The latest dated fact is the 5 October 2026 count.

[On 13 October 2022 the Ministry of Finance announced the E-GP portal was operational](<https://namibiadailynews.info/namibia-to-promote-accountability-transparency-through-e-procurement/>), publishing bid advertisements, documents, opening reports and notices of award. [Namibia's Procurement Policy Unit says all public entities must upload plans, bid adverts, bidding documents, opening reports and award notices to it](<https://appn-racop.org/upidrots/2025/05/Mr.-Phineas-Nsundano-PRESENTATION-on-the-Impact-of-MAPS-AND-E-GP-Namibia.pdf>). [An end-to-end platform is planned as phase two](<https://appn-racop.org/upidrots/2025/05/Mr.-Phineas-Nsundano-PRESENTATION-on-the-Impact-of-MAPS-AND-E-GP-Namibia.pdf>). [World Bank expert Devesh Mishra said fewer than 5% of public entities use the portal](<https://www.namibian.com.na/world-bank-recommends-end-to-end-e-government-procurement-system/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives the tenders, value or share of purchasing through e-procurement. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives a figure for e-procurement: tenders, value or share of purchasing through it.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether government e-procurement is under way or in service in Niger. Every source found for it is dated 2022 or earlier. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that public procurement runs on paper.
